episode.title: Barça One Win from Matching Their Best Start

script.title: Barça One Win from Matching Their Best Start

turns.text: [excited] Today, Barça are one league win away from matching their best-ever start to a LaLiga season. It's Monday; welcome to Barça & Beyond. I'm George, here with Sarah.
turns.speaker: host

turns.text: Hi! Getafe is a big test.
turns.speaker: analyst

turns.text: We've also got Barça's basketball opener and LeBron's first appearance as a 76er.
turns.speaker: host

turns.text: That Getafe test carries a history chance: Barça have won all 7 league games, with Atlético and Betis 5 points back.
turns.speaker: host

turns.text: A win after the international break would match the club's best start, set by Tata Martino's side in 2013/14. That's a real marker.
turns.speaker: analyst

turns.text: Barça have won their last 22 LaLiga home games, yet the club warns that the break and Getafe make this tough. Do you buy it?
turns.speaker: host

turns.text: I do. That home run raises expectations; it doesn't make another win automatic. The other encouraging sign is Raphinha's form.
turns.speaker: analyst

turns.text: Barça won 3–1 at Sevilla, with a Raphinha hat-trick; they beat Feyenoord 5–1, with his brace leading the way. Barça host Getafe on Saturday the 10th.
turns.speaker: host

turns.text: That lead looks especially valuable after the derby. Atlético beat Real Madrid 2–1 at home; Grimaldo and Jonathan David scored before Rüdiger's late reply.
turns.speaker: host

turns.text: And Atlético are 5 points behind Barça, while Madrid are 6 back. Alongside Betis, Atlético are the nearest challengers.
turns.speaker: analyst

turns.text: So the record chance sits alongside a genuine race at the top.
turns.speaker: host

turns.text: Yes. I'd keep an eye on Atlético after that derby, without forgetting Betis are level with them.
turns.speaker: analyst

turns.text: The contrast for Atlético is Europe: Liverpool beat Atleti 2–1 at home after Marcos Llorente had put them ahead.
turns.speaker: host

turns.text: That's a different opening from Barça's European win. Dominik Szoboszlai was named player of the match for Liverpool.
turns.speaker: analyst

turns.text: Elsewhere, PSG beat Slovan Bratislava 6–1, with a Ferran Torres hat-trick; Bayern beat Bodø/Glimt 5–0, with a Michael Olise brace.
turns.speaker: host

turns.text: Barça's next European test is away: Galatasaray host them on Tuesday the 13th.
turns.speaker: analyst

turns.text: Barça's basketball team kept the club's winning week going: Barça beat Leyma Coruña 119–101 at home in their Liga ACB opener.
turns.speaker: host

turns.text: [excited] Quite an opener for Aleksander Sekulic's new-look side. The club says it's Barça's highest league score since 2017/18.
turns.speaker: analyst

turns.text: Olek Balcerowski stood out, matching his ACB career-high in points and setting a personal best performance rating. What carries over?
turns.speaker: host

turns.text: Confidence. Barça also beat Anadolu Efes 89–82 in their EuroLeague opener, giving this new-look group wins in both competitions.
turns.speaker: analyst

turns.text: They won't have long to savour it: Dubai Basketball host Barça tomorrow.
turns.speaker: host

turns.text: Madrid's domestic opener was far tighter than Barça's: Real Madrid beat Unicaja 89–87 at home.
turns.speaker: host

turns.text: Madrid needed a 12–1 run in the final period to come back. The league report named Maledon their standout.
turns.speaker: analyst

turns.text: That makes Barça's opening score feel even more striking. Elsewhere, iLERNA Lleida beat Valencia Basket 105–100 away.
turns.speaker: host

turns.text: Barça's domestic follow-up is this Sunday, away to UCAM Murcia.
turns.speaker: analyst

turns.text: Beyond Barça's opening win, Eurohoops reports the NBA has sent EuroLeague an offer for possible collaboration.
turns.speaker: host

turns.text: [curious] That could matter enormously to Barça's competition. But no details have emerged, and an offer isn't a deal.
turns.speaker: analyst

turns.text: Eurohoops says clubs and shareholders are expected to discuss it ahead of their meeting.
turns.speaker: host

turns.text: Neither organization commented on the report. For now, the questions are bigger than the answers.
turns.speaker: analyst

turns.text: That NBA connection brings us to LeBron James: he appeared at 76ers media day today after signing with Philadelphia in July.
turns.speaker: host

turns.text: James said his friendship with Tyrese Maxey and his desire to help Joel Embiid win his first title helped bring him there.
turns.speaker: analyst

turns.text: He'd envisioned finishing with the Knicks, but ruled it out after they won the title. That makes his choice of Philly fascinating.
turns.speaker: host

turns.text: Before we go, Barça visit Dubai Basketball tomorrow and UCAM Murcia this Sunday. In football, they host Getafe on Saturday the 10th, then visit Galatasaray on Tuesday the 13th. Thanks for listening to Barça & Beyond!
turns.speaker: host

turns.text: See you next time!
turns.speaker: analyst
